primitives.name: Narrative Contract
primitives.verbatim_quote: # narrative_contract: DARK -> STORED, and the exact steps to reach LIVE 2026-09-27.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes NFL player roster data is complete and accurate, and that the crosswalk mapping between NFL ID and GSIS ID is validated.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Applies to the transition from DARK (unverified) to LIVE (promoted) status for predictive features.

layer2.mapping: Maps the concept of a 'narrative contract' to a formalized process for promoting machine learning features in Galaxy Sports Engine (GSE) and Galaxy Sports Intelligence (GSI). Specifically, it aligns with the LiveEdgePart registry update and the WEEK3_ENGINE_READINGS dataset.
layer2.telemetry: Verification metrics include holdout accuracy, regression tests, and typechecks to ensure no unintended side effects.

primitives.name: Crosswalk Fix
primitives.verbatim_quote: The crosswalk fix made this family measurable for the first time, and it clears both honesty bars out of sample.
primitives.assumptions: Relies on the availability of a validated mapping between NFL-specific identifiers (nfl_id) and GSIS identifiers (gsis_id).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when the crosswalk mapping contains errors or when new player IDs appear without corresponding mappings.

layer2.mapping: Represents the alignment of data schemas across different systems (e.g., NFLVerse to GSE). It ensures that entities can be consistently tracked over time, enabling reliable holdout testing.
layer2.telemetry: Measures success through improved joinability rates and reduced data discrepancies in holdout samples.

primitives.name: Roster Joinability
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Why it was unmeasurable before Only 2023-2025 were roster-joinable, which left two training seasons.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes that roster data from 2023-2025 is sufficient for training models, and that joinability is necessary for holdout evaluation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when insufficient historical roster data exists, leading to small training sets that cannot generalize well.

layer2.mapping: Derives from the requirement for temporal consistency in player tracking. It is a prerequisite for applying the crosswalk fix and achieving measurable performance.
layer2.telemetry: Evaluated by the number of successfully joined roster records and the stability of holdout statistics.

primitives.name: Holdout Accuracy
primitives.verbatim_quote: The validated `nfl_id -> gsis_id` crosswalk made 2018-2024 joinable, giving seven seasons of training history and 2025 as a clean holdout.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes that the holdout sample (2025) is independent and identically distributed with respect to the training data.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when the holdout period contains anomalies or distribution shifts that violate the i.i.d. assumption.

layer2.mapping: Maps to the empirical evaluation of predictive models using a held-out test set. It provides an unbiased estimate of generalization error.
layer2.telemetry: Monitored through metrics such as correlation (`r`), slope, standard error, and coverage thresholds (e.g., `|r| >= 0.08`).
